title: Audit booking constraints
summary: Report invalid booking intervals, missing rooms, capacity violations, and overlapping reservations.
objectives: Translate booking rules into explicit constraint checks.
Detect relationships that are missing a foreign key.
Express an overlap rule that a simple UNIQUE constraint cannot enforce.
Combine independent constraint audits into one deterministic result.
constraints: Return exactly the columns issue, entity_id, and detail in that order.
Order rows by issue ascending, then entity_id ascending, then detail ascending.
An invalid interval has starts_at greater than or equal to ends_at, regardless of status.
Capacity violations ignore cancelled bookings and allow party_size equal to capacity.
Overlap checks only compare non-cancelled bookings that have a valid interval.
Report each overlapping pair once, using the lower booking id as entity_id.
Return no rows when the data is clean.

examples.explanation: A booking must end after it starts, even when it is cancelled.
